notes: New Atlas look: the globe fills the screen like an operations room, with a live status strip (UTC, feeds, layers, entities, solar), a layer rail with counts, a hideable intel panel and an events and markets ticker. The core has instrument rings and orbiting lights. Also: backup and restore to a USB drive (Settings, Backup), local weather once you set your town, ask about your files ("summarise report.docx"), screen questions (Win+Shift+S, dev.27 image) and media controls in the Control Centre.
